Terms & Conditions

Draft for this prototype. This page describes demo behavior and is not a completed production legal document.

1. Service scope2. Accounts and access3. Acceptable use4. Plans and billing5. Cancellation and refunds6. Accuracy and responsibility7. Business and legal details

1. Service scope

AluMaster in this project is an interactive demonstration of a proposed SaaS product. It does not provide live payments, real identity verification, engineering calculations, or production PDF generation.

2. Accounts and access

Demo access uses a fixed verification code and browser records. It is not a secure authentication system. Production account eligibility, responsibilities, and role enforcement must be specified.

3. Acceptable use

Use this demonstration for evaluating the interface and workflows. Do not enter confidential client information or rely on sample measurements for fabrication.

4. Plans and billing

Listed plans illustrate the proposed commercial offer. Annual pricing applies the displayed 20% discount. Demo checkout does not create a paid contract or automatic renewal.

5. Cancellation and refunds

No money is collected in this demonstration. A production cancellation and refund policy has not been selected and must be added before live purchases are enabled.

6. Accuracy and responsibility

Sample material quantities and interface previews are illustrative. Production estimates must be validated against the actual profiles, dimensions, fabrication requirements, and supplier specifications.

7. Business and legal details

The contracting entity, applicable jurisdiction, dispute process, liability provisions, and support channels require business decisions and legal review before publication.
